name: Weekend in Waimanalo
original_name: ウィークエンド・イン・ワイマナロ
source:
Rachel and Zoe have just had their second anniversary and things are not going well for them. A lot of the romance and passion has left their relationship and while they have talked about breaking up, they simply cannot imagine a life without one another. So, thanks to a recommendation from a friend, they book a weekend at a luxurious lesbian-only resort in the Hawaii to receive couple’s therapy from the legendary Dr. Mia Arroyo. During their sessions, Dr. Arroyo finds the curious reason why their relationship is not quite working and gives them a surprising recommendation as to how to save their marriage and re-discover themselves and each other!

Weekend in Waimanalo is a romantic comedy yuri visual novel and dating sim. This is a game about love, respect, friendship, self-exploration, and mental health. Explore this hidden side of Oahu, get to know interesting characters, and see how your decisions affect where Rachel ends up and with who!
translation:
雷切尔和佐伊刚刚度过了结婚两周年纪念日，但他们的生活并不顺利。他们的关系已经失去了很多浪漫和激情，虽然他们谈到了分手，但他们根本无法想象没有彼此的生活。因此，在朋友的推荐下，他们在夏威夷的一家豪华女同性恋度假胜地预订了一个周末，接受传奇人物米娅·阿罗约医生的夫妻治疗。在他们的治疗过程中，阿罗约博士发现了他们的关系不太顺利的奇怪原因，并就如何挽救他们的婚姻并重新发现自己和彼此提出了令人惊讶的建议！

怀马纳洛的周末是一部浪漫喜剧尤里视觉小说和约会模拟游戏。这是一款关于爱、尊重、友谊、自我探索和心理健康的游戏。探索欧胡岛隐藏的一面，认识有趣的人物，看看你的决定如何影响瑞秋的结局以及与谁在一起！
